title: Formula for the correlated Gaussian density
statement: Let $0<\rho<1$ and $z_1,z_2\in\mathbb{R}$. The correlated Gaussian density is $\displaystyle \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\sqrt{2\pi(1-\rho^2)}}\exp\!\left(-\frac{z_1^2-2\rho z_1z_2+z_2^2}{2(1-\rho^2)}\right)$.
